wholePhysicalScope: Queensland building data supplies two independent roof envelopes. Three topographic points name Normanton Gaol at those envelopes, on the registered site or immediately adjoining its surveyed edge. The larger southwest outline covers the cell ranges; the small rear outline contains the quarters. Open yard walls are inferred inside the heritage site.
lodDetails: Four levels retain both mapped roofs, the open exercise yards, iron doors, and the covered weatherboard porch. Nearer levels resolve ventilation rails, iron hoods and louvres.
limitations: The two roof envelopes come from QRA mapping. The exact exercise yard divisions, core and annex roof breakpoints, porch depth and entrance positions are reconstructed from written facts.
Roof elevations and paint are estimates. Interior fabric, furnishings and proposed park additions are outside scope.
Original terrain stays unchanged; door thresholds and foundation elevations are approximate.
